:::{#def-angle-unit-circle}
#### Angle on the unit circle

The **angle** between two points of the [unit circle](#def-unit-circle)
is how far apart they are along the circle, going the short way round, measured in [radians](#def-radian).
Let the counterclockwise distance from the first point to the second be $s \in [0, 2\pi)$.
Then the angle is

$$
\angpar \eqdef \min\cb{s, 2\pi - s}.
$$

In words, the angle is the smaller of two distances from the first point to the second:
the counterclockwise one, $s$, or the clockwise one, $2\pi - s$.

:::
